title: `/` and `//` on integers
description: In DuckDB, `/` on integers is float division and `//` is integer division; the setting `integer_division` switches `/`.
reference: The lift reads `/` as DuckDB does: it divides as doubles, and `//` divides integers.

provenance.notes: Recorded from the replay's translation of DuckDB's SQL to DataFusion's (`sverify_dev.slt.translate`).
